notes.title: Ver. 1.10 Update Content
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]  Added "CHAOS" difficulty.
[*]  Added new raid enemies to post-game world map.
[*]  Added characters that can be used for Assault Actions.
[*]  Added new weapons, armor, accessories, and key items.
[*]  Added new craftable weapons to IC Customization.
[*]  Adjusted ally symbologist AI.
[*]  Added a feature that allows players to choose whether or not their level is carried over when carrying over save data.
[*]  Added a feature that changes the title screen once the game has been beaten.
[*]  Added text to be displayed when using Oracle.
[*]  Added playback features to the Ending Collection under the title screen's "Special" option.
[*]  Added "Char. Graphics Collection" under the title screen's "Special" option.
[*]  Miscellaneous bug fixes.
[/list]
